05

Technical problem-solving

My troubleshooting approach

I solve problems one step at a time.

When a network cannot connect, an application does not start or hardware does not respond, I begin with the simplest checks and test one possible cause at a time.

diagnostic.log
$ ping 10.2.2.2
Reply received — path reachable
$ tracert 10.2.2.2
Checking route one hop at a time...
✓ Cause of the problem identified
  1. 01

    Define the problem

    Record what failed, what still works and how the problem can be reproduced.

  2. 02

    Check the foundations

    Verify power, connections, interfaces, addressing and configuration.

  3. 03

    Isolate the cause

    Use focused tests to identify the system component or network layer causing the problem.

  4. 04

    Test one solution

    Change one variable at a time and compare the result.

  5. 05

    Verify and document

    Confirm that the full service works and record the final solution.
